public_causal_transport.rule: End-to-end method comparison and causal transport remain in one public lane but are separate estimands. Causal transport freezes pre-treatment eligibility, common starting state, one common realized/content-addressed T_K_public, common verifier/served action, common updater/config/budget/order/evaluation, and changes only g(T_K_public).

public_replication.rule: Deterministic full evolution may use one realization. If evolution remains stochastic, use the same preregistered 3 paired full-evolution seeds for affected unified-rerun methods. Heldout repeats are separate measurement-noise replicates.

rules: Do not claim or title the result as globally best-to-act versus best-to-learn.
B2+B3 may only establish the tested alternative learner projection outperforming WIN-C on the five preregistered procedural skeletons while serving is fixed.
Frontend aggregate 0/5 is labeled execution gates/status flags, not scientific execution authority.
Public anchor is Universal MRW4 or a prospectively frozen public-compatible alternative.
